title: Opportunity Title
dek: One concise sentence describing the opportunity and its research focus.
body: Explain who the opportunity is for and what collaborators may work on.
Describe possible research areas, expected outputs, and how scope and responsibilities will be agreed.
perks: Describe a realistic benefit such as flexible coordination or feedback.
Describe a concrete artifact or learning opportunity.
Explain how contribution credit will be handled without guaranteeing authorship.
requirements: State expectations for communication and documentation.
Include research ethics, data permissions, and attribution where relevant.
fitIf: Describe the type of person who could succeed in the opportunity.
Describe the interests, habits, or working style that would make someone a good fit.
preferred: List useful but non-mandatory skills or experience.
Invite a short example of previous work or a proposed research question.
engagementNote: Clarify whether this is employment or an independent collaboration, and state how funding, expenses, deliverables, attribution, and authorship expectations will be agreed.
